# Overview

PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC’s operations involve collaboration among the data, technology, and marketing teams, specifically in the areas of pipeline tracking and customer acquisition reporting. These teams currently work with key business systems and data sources, including Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and QuickBooks, all of which provide critical input to the firm’s reporting processes.

The organization utilizes a robust technology stack comprising Salesforce for CRM, Tamarac for portfolio management, and Microsoft’s Azure-based platforms, including Azure Blob Storage, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Synapse, to manage and process data. Power BI is established as the primary tool for reporting and analytics, offering stakeholders a suite of existing dashboards and visualizations. Integration of QuickBooks into the reporting environment is ongoing and represents an identified challenge, particularly regarding data ingestion and quality for customer acquisition cost (CAC) tracking.

All core infrastructure is cloud-based, anchored by Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse data platforms. Existing reporting workflows are primarily batch-processed through automated pipelines. Manual processes and data governance policies are not detailed in the current documentation.
